pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal patches with sharp pixel-level edge gradients. The patches on the cervical region are larger and more contiguous, while the patches on the thoracic and abdominal flank are smaller, more fragmented, and exhibit higher edge angularity.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-tan pathways separating the dark patches. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial. Pathway thickness is maximal on the upper neck and decreases as the network branches toward the ventral and posterior regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A dark brown mane is visible along the superior neck line, displaying a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette of short, vertical hairs.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A prominent structural protrusion is visible on the dorsal ridge posterior to the shoulder. This area shows significant textural disruption and lighter pigmentation compared to the surrounding pelage.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A localized, raised structural abnormality is present on the mid-dorsal line, characterized by a loss of standard patch-and-corridor topology and an altered, bulbous contour.
